citations.context: Um, but that was actually probably one of the first free decisions I had made in my life. I'd realized every decision I'd made up until that point, um, at least as an adult, I was doing my best to do what I believed God wanted me to do. And at this that that moment I got into a place where I was willing to do what I thought was best. And and it was it was really weird to feel bad about just wanting to do what you think is is best. Do y'all have any thoughts or uh on on that type of situation?

text.KJV: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
text.WEB: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
